content.short: Sherlock is an audit marketplace and smart contract coverage protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain.
content.description: Sherlock differentiates itself from traditional audit firms by tying incentives to verifiable outcomes rather than relying on reputation alone. Instead of charging steep upfront fees, Sherlock provides financial reassurance through a staking pool that can cover bug bounty payouts or remediation costs in USDC, aligning incentives with real security results. In addition, the platform emphasizes transparency around who performs audits, openly sharing auditor qualifications to prevent brands from masking gaps in talent. This approach fosters stronger accountability and a clearer, more trustworthy view of audit reliability for stakeholders.
